headlines.snippet: It has been cleared for publication that Sgt. Ron Yonatan Reitman and Sgt. Yuval Shai Suwailm fell in a terrorist attack at the Judea junction. Reitman, 23, from Ashkelon, and Suwailm, 20, from Hod HaSharon, served in the Ari Battalion of the Rescue Brigade. Three other soldiers were moderately and lightly wounded. The IDF estimates that the terrorists planned a larger attack against civilians, which was thwarted by the soldiers' actions. The two terrorists were eliminated, and an investigation is underway regarding a foreign photographer who may have known about the attack in advance. Netanyahu ordered an immediate lockdown of Hebron and preparations for a full closure in the West Bank.
